HW - Ignored QMs (IQMs)

I've been spending a few hours trying to find solid examples of IQMs. Aside from FTRs, I find this HW to be higher on the difficulty scale.

Here is (what I think) I found regarding IQMs: 1. To trade IQMs, we should find the DP to ignore the QM level and enter from that DP 2. The target for IQMs are the closest ignored SD zone or SR 3. IQMs are good only for scalps (if trading in the same TF) 4. Not all IQMs are tradeable. We should look for HTF zones that the QM should react to which then failed to safely trade them. No defined zones, no trade.

Hi all, Just wanna let you know I'm still here and currently not posting because I'm actively devouring everything that can be read inside this wonderful site.

As this is my personal space and currently feeling super emotionally charged right now, I'll write some things just to clear up my conscience.

A sad, disgusting thing has just happened in my country, Indonesia. I call it the death of democracy. Just to cut the story short, a good, hardworking governor that actually showed results in his work, was sentenced to 2 years imprisonment just because of quoting a verse from the Qur'an.

He "lost" the re-election a month ago, which, IMHO, was a load of horse crap and definitely rigged.

The other party, which supposedly "won" the election, was the same person who used money from the government (read: money from hardworking, honest-to-God civilians) to fund for his "case study" abroad a few years ago, which was way beyond budget. His dumb agenda, for those who actually thinks with their God-given brains, should be clear: to make money from the hard work of honest people without lifting his ass off the couch.

What's even worse, the country has been injected with stupid propaganda and hate speeches directed especially to minorities of the chinese descent.

The sentenced governor is chinese and Christian. How convenient to use that against him.

For the first time, I can actually feel what IF has been writing about in his journal regarding the dictators that rule countries and the world.

I usually don't care about politics, but this issue has become so severe that I just can't stop thinking about for this past month. This is the first time I lost hope in the human race. I've always thought that this kinda thing always have a way out. I am proven wrong. I feel despair.

More importantly, I feel that the future of my family will be affected negatively in the future, as I am also of chinese descent. As of now, I'm focusing all my energy to think for a way out of this country. A prosperous life is not a good life at all if everyday we fear getting killed.

and no, I'm not supporting the governor just because he is chinese and Christian. I would vouch for him even if he is a muslim and native Indonesian. This is not a hate speech directed to any particular political parties, beliefs, religion, racial background, or anything. This is hate directed towards INJUSTICE. I truly hate how good, honest people are treated like trash every single day. Jakarta, no, even Indonesia, doesn't deserve even 1/10th of this governor's ability.

It makes me sick to think that virtually almost every government in this world operate in almost the same manner. Trying to control and hoard resources for personal enrichment by sacrificing other good people's hard work. Disgusting is the key word here.

Pardon my ramblings. Sorry if I have offended anyone here. I meant no disrespect to anyone or anything. I'll get back to RTM topics again as soon as I'm done devouring papers

the 3-D is closer to compression approach, which often couples well with QM/DM reaction.

DM is basically a trick to trap QM traders (incl. SnD & S/R traders) because QMers think that the the Head of the left shoulder has touched a true supply (MPL), whereas in reality the head just touched the RS or SR of the true supply FL.

The main problem i do have is: often times, when we read the market wrong, i.e. thinking the head is a important FL not seen in that momentary TF chart), QM/DM trade should not work & often dont work but they sometimes do, only to miss my tg and hit SL turning my trades into losses.

Just be really careful. it has something to do with what Edge & Gregg is prepping atm.

In the meantime, i'd suggest you find the ones that we'd think would work well had we been in the moment to trade it, but then lost/failed. I'd found these exercises to be most challenging, because the reasons for failures could be numerous and sometimes bring you to the point of overcomplication. just be careful and stick to the most obvious reasons, dont try to make sense out of something unconfirmed/unproven, because it did burn me out into exhaustion a few times.

I've found DM to be the true essence of many of IF's trades.

many call it Fake-Out, too. so Aaron's work: Engulf vs Fake-out should bring u up to speed in conjunction with this one.
